fields.label: Period
fields.description: The period number documents carry. 0 = OPN; 1..n regular; then closing and adjustment periods. Unique in the year; 0 to 255.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Short name, e.g. OPN, P01, CLS, P14. Unique in the year.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Display name, e.g. Jan 2025. Blank shows the code.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Regular periods tile the year. Opening is period 0 on the first day; Closing and Adjustment come after the last regular period. Which types take trial balances is set in EPM Settings.

fields.label: Quarter
fields.description: Quarter for quarterly and half-year reporting (Q1-Q2 = H1). Generate Periods fills it for Monthly and 4-4-5; 13-period years leave it blank.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: On or after Start Date. Opening and Closing periods are one day: the year's first or last.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set by Close Period, Lock Period and Reopen Period, or by the year's actions. Never looser than the year's.
